verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Stripe Tax provides rule-based calculation, reporting, and a taxability_reason field for API results, but there is no evidence of a conversational AI/chatbot answering ad-hoc questions like 'is this taxable in this state' with citations. This is a rules/API engine, not an AI-agent Q&A interface. Missing for 10: any AI chat/assistant interface, natural-language Q&A capability, citation-backed reasoning beyond a single API field.
